description: This file defines a test case class for SDK-related operations, including running commands, fetching files, and verifying ELF binaries, for use in automated testing within a build environment.

classes.name: OESDKTestCase
classes.description: A test case class for running SDK-related tests, including command execution, file retrieval, and ELF binary verification.

methods.name: _run(self, cmd)
methods.description: Executes a shell command with the environment set by self.tc.sdk_env, capturing output.

methods.name: fetch(self, workdir, dl_dir, url, archive=None)
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL into a specified directory, or fetches it from cache if already downloaded.

methods.name: check_elf(self, path, target_os=None, target_arch=None)
methods.description: Verifies that an ELF binary matches the specified or default target OS and architecture.

ctags.name: fetch
ctags.pattern: /^    def fetch(self, workdir, dl_dir, url, archive=None):$/
